applicationEvidence.reason: Curaçao has no required postal-code search key or eligible real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon. Shared runtime/UI tests verify fail-closed area contracts but cannot promote draft planning cells, an unverified four-digit validator or synthetic CW codes.

reproducibility.pdfInspection: pdfplumber full page-count scan plus exact page-marker validation against the byte/SHA-256-bound UPU PDFs
reproducibility.pdfRender: Poppler rendered the one-page CW sheet and physical page 4 of the no-postcode list to non-empty 1191x1684 RGB PNGs with sha256:15cc74c775f1c2836860408b968d6c7b4b448281c9a66db3d57e78d7c8b7f576 and sha256:aaea202d399c66148d084ed0ca57750567ed6a9c468b3b534bf6f6d294501d5e; the local view helper failed with Windows error 206 even at short paths
reproducibility.addressMetadataCorrection: CW JSON, YAML and generated Americas hierarchy now represent postalCode format None, regex/api null and no postalCode rule; no code was invented.
reproducibility.geometryTransformation: none; no address, code, coordinate or geometry was copied, transformed or promoted into Git
reproducibility.visualizationDecision: No chart or separate Data App was added because the authoritative denominator is zero postal codes and zero eligible postal geometry; the rollout's canonical Markdown and JSON reports preserve exact receipts and explicit zero counts without implying an area dataset.

limitations: The UPU September 2025 list establishes current no-postcode status; it does not authorize a placeholder code or postal surface.
The current Cpost pages describe address, postal-box and pickup services but do not publish a complete assignment table or postal geometry.
A 2026 Cpost copyright notice is not an open data licence, and the reviewed bodies publish no reusable postal dataset.
Draft CW country-pack localities, planning cells and test vectors are synthetic planning material and are not Cpost assignments.
No browser E2E was run because there is no valid CW postcode input or eligible real CW postal area artifact to render.

Both UPU pages rendered successfully, but the local image-view helper failed with Windows error 206; exact bytes, page counts, text markers, render dimensions and render SHA-256 values were validated.
